notes: Both fetches of www.littlehotelier.com (pricing, then home) answered HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare block page (thin), so requests to that host stopped. In pass 2 the pricing, home, PMS and best-hotel-pms pages were each read once in a real browser and the claims were re-classed from those snapshots. SiteMinder lines were split three ways: backed or built by SiteMinder (ownership, still unverifiable because no page states ownership), powered by SiteMinder (X by Y naming, true) and distribution on SiteMinder's network (integrations, true). Room-count targets (1 to 30 rooms, under 20 rooms), ease-of-use and training-time lines, rankings, the 100 million reservations line (a volume, not a customer count) and the eviivo price line in q6 Claude 2 (about another vendor) were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): C01, C02, C07, C09, C11, C12, C13, C16, C17, C18 and C19 unverifiable to true; C03 unverifiable to wrong (the pricing page publishes From prices, the answers say Custom); C04, C05, C06, C08, C10, C14 and C15 stay unverifiable with new reasons. C16 was reworded to the Google Hotel Ads integration because the pages place it under Hotel Metasearch, not the channel manager. Added C20 (450+ channels, two instances) and two C12 instances from vendor sub-headings in q5 Claude 1 and 3; the gap lines held no other in-scope statement about Little Hotelier. Cause tracing for C03: six cited pages tried (hoteltech.review, gourmetmarketing, stayfi, hotelogix, amenitiz read; canarytechnologies disallowed by robots.txt), none calls the pricing custom, so the cause is not found. The page budget for this vendor stands at 12 of 14.
